notation: Logical Arabic in the engine notation (engines.mmbn). Keep every command of the original, in order: < and > move the speaker's mouth, \p waits for a key, {cls N} clears the box, {d N} and {fd N} wait inside the text, and the {raw ...} commands set flags, give items or animate Lan. Line ends (\n) may move. Item names printed from the game's tables are written as text; Latin words (PET, WWW, MegaMan.EXE, the buttons) keep the game's own glyphs.

glossary.notes: the program's name keeps the game's Latin glyphs, like PET
